currentWork.title: Field maintenance — same-visit OCR continuation + automatic OCR start
currentWork.releaseStatus: FINAL.20 candidate is preview-verified. Real-device use exposed `Visit vendor mismatch` when a confirmed sales journal was followed by input/recovery capture in the same visit. The root cause was Analytics requiring every report in a visit to share one vendorKey even when the visit already had a trusted machineId. FINAL.20 makes trusted same-machine identity authoritative for visit continuity while preserving each report's own maker/vendor identity; vendor mismatch still fails closed when no trusted same-machine context exists, and a different machineId still fails closed. Captured images now start OCR automatically; the OCR button is hidden on the normal path and appears only as retry after OCR failure/unavailability. Preview dedicated continuation/auto-OCR, OCR field, visit-closeout/overlap, machine-bring opt-in, and app smoke gates pass. Analytics engine is AN14B3B5; DB/schema remain 4.
scope: Allow related reports with different vendor identities to share one visit only when they resolve to the same trusted machineId.
Inherit the trusted visit machineId onto a continued report before enforcing vendor mismatch.
Keep vendor mismatch fail-closed when neither side establishes the same trusted machine.
Keep machine mismatch fail-closed when report and visit point to different machines.
Start OCR automatically after a valid captured/selected image when the OCR adapter is available.
Hide the manual OCR control during the normal path; expose it only as retry when OCR is unavailable or fails.
Keep explicit draft approval and explicit report confirmation unchanged; do not auto-confirm or auto-link a new machine mapping.
Keep inventory semantics and Analytics DB/schema unchanged.
